# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.6.0

Feature release focused on the doorbell camera media path and native-agent
stability.

## Highlights

- Updates the native C300X device agent to `0.6.0`.
- Starts the on-demand doorbell camera through the app-style SIP/SRTP media
  path, matching the C300X mobile app more closely than the short doorbell-call
  video window.
- Keeps normal Home Assistant camera opening video-only so the frontend can
  autoplay the live view, while interactive WebRTC sessions can still request
  audio and talkback.
- Fixes a stale RTSP listener lifecycle issue that could leave port `6554`
  open inside the agent process and cause `video_activate_failed` on the next
  camera start.

## Update note

After updating the Home Assistant integration, run the device-agent update
Repair if Home Assistant offers it. The integration and native agent should both
report `0.6.0` after the update has completed and the integration has reloaded.

## Notes

- This release keeps the Home Assistant minimum version at `2026.5.0`.
- The agent API remains local HTTP on the trusted LAN. Keep browser/front-end
  access on HTTPS when using microphone/talkback features.
